_readme: S14R-0002 tunable constants, calibrated from the 14-burst S14R corpora (runs/daemon/runs/{s14r-0000-16h16,s14r-0000-17h43,s14r-and-r2..r5,s14r-ios-r1..r7}); see reports/s14r-0002-*.md for the A/B evidence. Page + firmware read these as compiled defaults; the serial CFG channel can override the page keys live.

brightness_probe.objective: predicted per-lamp burst amp headroom = P90 of lamp-core pixels (5x5 core max) minus local background ring median during the solid-ON probe — drive lamp cores to the JUST-BELOW-CLIP knee (saturated cores strangle amp; starved cores waste SNR)
brightness_probe.adjust: multiplicative L_new = L * targetP90 / measuredP90 (clamped to ±1.5x per step)
brightness_probe.telemetry: BSTATS per probe step {L, P90, clipPct, histMed} + final {bright, histMed, clipPct, probeIters}

corpus_calibration.note: all 14 S14R bursts overdrove: lamp-core clipPct 17.1-56.0% (bBurstB 150 fixed), coreP90 = 255 everywhere — the [235,250]/<=5% knee band is the calibrated NEW ground the probe aims at, not an observed-corpora regime; frame-p95 band 225-245 retained as the exposure-class sanity check

evidence.s14r-and-r5 (histMed 83.5): thr 93.5: 387->386 (hairline site 398 blur 100.9 amp 44.5 flips argmax; documented cost)

exposure.androidEvBiasNote: 03 Oct operator call: stays -1; the -3 intent never landed in a real burst (all 25 first-0002 readbacks ev=-1), all calibration corpora ran at -1, iOS ignores it
exposure.iosPoi: no evBias; POI tap + flash feedback + re-assert each burst
